intent: Per-service write-only secrets stored in Nomad Variables behind secrets.Provider, replaced declaratively on every deploy

decisions.decision: One Nomad Variable per service at nomad/jobs/<app>/<service>
decisions.why: Nomad implicit task access is exact paths; the group path isolates each service with no extra ACL
decisions.rejected: one variable at nomad/jobs/<app> readable by every task

decisions.decision: Env template with toJSON values, change_mode noop
decisions.why: go-envparse double quotes take exactly JSON escapes; noop keeps values out of running copies
decisions.rejected: values in job Env; change_mode restart

decisions.decision: Kept copy of replaced sets at nomad/jobs/<app>/caravana/previous, owned by deployment ID
decisions.why: restores the running version secrets on failure, survives restarts, never in SQLite

decisions.decision: Secret {name, value?}: no value means keep; stored definition has names only
decisions.why: a read app redeploys as keep-everything; one fewer field

decisions.decision: Nomad provider lives in internal/deploy, interface in internal/secrets
decisions.why: constitution VI keeps Nomad code in deploy and nomadjob

decisions.decision: Nomad unreachable during a secrets call is both ErrUnavailable and ErrNomadUnavailable
decisions.why: the API keeps answering nomad_unavailable for a down Nomad, even for apps without secrets
decisions.rejected: a new code for every Nomad outage

decisions.decision: checkSecrets builds the sets before saving whenever the app has secrets
decisions.why: a bad keep, an oversized set or an unreachable store saves nothing

plan.summary: Per-service secrets in Nomad Variables behind secrets.Provider, with a kept copy for restore
plan.key_finding: Nomad workload identity reads only exact paths, and go-envparse accepts JSON string escapes

implement.summary: Per-service write-only secrets in Nomad Variables behind secrets.Provider, console Secrets section, API 0.6.0, gate step

approach: Secrets are per-service {name, value?} on app.Service; values are stripped before saving. The service builds full sets and hands them to secrets.Provider (deploy.Variables writes nomad/jobs/<app>/<service>, keeps the replaced sets for Restore/Commit by deployment). The translator adds an env template with toJSON values and change_mode noop.
